scope: RVOL ONLY — the EMA family is specified and frozen separately in MASSIVE_COARSE_EMA_FEATURE_SPEC_V1; no EMA parameter is referenced here

resolves.tenth: zero-denominator handling, which surfaced during this freeze and was not among the original nine

decisions.value: 20 prior eligible sessions, same security_key_v1, same session type

decisions.rationale: an 'expected volume' baseline; the mean preserves the additive interpretation that CUM-RVOL also relies on

decisions.rule: < 15 valid prior observations at that slot -> UNAVAILABLE
decisions.never: lowered security by security to raise availability

decisions.rule: the baseline is strictly prior-only; the current session may never enter its own denominator
at most the last 20 matching prior eligible sessions

decisions.charter_position: this remains charter-authorised 1m CLOCK measurement, not a 1m-native signal family

decisions.rule: normal-session and early-close baselines are independent

decisions.value: arithmetic mean of prior-session CUMULATIVE volumes through the same slot
decisions.explicitly_not: sum of per-slot means, which would be a shortcut
decisions.historical_sample_validity: a prior session contributes only if its cumulative path from slot 1 through slot k is uninterrupted by any UNOBSERVED expected minute
decisions.same_policy: last 20 same-session-type prior sessions, minimum 15 valid cumulative samples, arithmetic mean
decisions.current_session: once the current cumulative path crosses an UNOBSERVED minute it carries the charter's contaminated/unavailable state from that point forward; missing volume is never 0

decisions.rationale: real regular-session vendor volume exists there and no evidence identifies what fraction is an auction print; EXCLUDING them would be an equally unproven semantic assumption

explicitly_not: bare numeric NULL without a reason

decision_provenance: every value was supplied explicitly; no default, convention or 'standard' value was added

zero_denominator.zero_samples_remain_valid: the 15+ genuine observed zero-volume samples stay valid observations; they are NOT ejected from the baseline merely because their mean is 0

epsilon_floor_forbidden.why: an unregistered numerical regularization that silently converts an undefined ratio into a plausible-looking finite one

early_close_consequence.finding: early-close RVOL is UNAVAILABLE BY CONSTRUCTION in this V1 window

arithmetic.conclusion: ten prior same-type sessions can never supply fifteen

early_close_consequence.classification: PRE-REGISTERED DESIGN CONSEQUENCE, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT
early_close_consequence.accepted_tradeoff: not pooling two different volume shapes into one baseline, and not inventing a lower minimum for early-close sessions
early_close_consequence.recorded_now_because: it would otherwise be reported later as a bug

inherited_from_frozen_authority.baseline_membership: the per-slot baseline is computed over OBSERVED and STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE minutes only; UNOBSERVED minutes are excluded from both numerator and denominator
inherited_from_frozen_authority.cumulative_contamination: a cumulative curve crossing an UNOBSERVED minute is flagged from that point forward for that session
inherited_from_frozen_authority.mandatory_reporting: every RVOL-family feature reports the count of excluded UNOBSERVED minutes alongside its value
inherited_from_frozen_authority.unobserved_never_zero: an UNOBSERVED minute is NEVER coerced to zero volume, in storage, in aggregation, or in any feature

structural_no_trade.consequence: the charter admits STRUCTURAL_NO_TRADE into the baseline, but this programme cannot prove its preconditions, so in practice the baseline is built from OBSERVED minutes only and the excluded count is reported

causality.prior_only: the current session never enters its own denominator

one_minute_role.justification: slot-RVOL and CUM-RVOL measure a session-level volume state and time when within the session it is reached — the permitted use of 1m under the charter

legacy_exclusions.why: occurrence in historical code is not pre-registration

thresholds.emitted: continuous quantities plus validity metadata only

feature_validity_vs_cohort.rule: a security stays in the frozen cohort even when RVOL is UNAVAILABLE
feature_validity_vs_cohort.forbidden: constructing a cleaner cohort from feature availability

governance_guard.rule: if implementation surfaces a further required semantic parameter that is neither in these ten decisions nor in the frozen charter, HOLD
governance_guard.precedent: the tenth parameter was found exactly this way

next_step: RVOL feature smoke + label-free capability, then RVOL production. Not started here.
